sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Shichimen Warriors (七面武者, Seven-faced Warrior) are Mini-Boss enemies in Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice. They are practitioners of necromancy located in Abandoned Dungeon, Ashina Depths and Fountainhead Palace.
One is found in the Bottomless Hole. When approached, a fogwall will block the path to the Bottomless Hole Sculptor's Idol.
Another will appear in the Guardian Ape's Burrow after killing Headless Ape, obtaining, and fitting the Finger Whistle prosthetic. After it spawns, the nearby idol will be disabled. If you have yet to enter the Hidden Forest and commune with its idol prior to obtaining the Finger Whistle, the area becomes inaccessible until after killing this boss.
Lastly, he's encountered in the Fountainhead Palace at the foot of a waterfall. Some Palace Dogs are also found near the end of the stream.
